body.message:
Dear Sir,

It has now been more than an hour since I requested an alternative contact option from you. While you replied that the number provided is the only one available, which I understand, I am still unclear on how customers calling from abroad are expected to discuss booking details before making a reservation.

Furthermore, I informed you yesterday evening that the website link you provided is not functioning. Unfortunately, this issue has not been acknowledged or addressed.

As mentioned, I requested an alternative option for my next stat, but I have not received a response to that request. This is not the first time I have had to follow up multiple times before receiving a reply. Even when responses are provided, they often do not fully address my questions.

I do not believe this reflects the service standards of your company, especially considering the level of assistance I have previously received from other members of your team.

Please consider this email as a formal complaint which I will escalate it to your supervisor or the appropriate management team, as I expect a higher level of customer service and professionalism.

Thank you for your attention. I sincerely hope that someone else will be able to assist me more effectively and provide the support I require.

Kind Regards
